caption_L1: Mean earnings in the United States from 2005 to 2019 , by highest educational degree earned is a area graph. The x-axis shows Level of Education while the y-axis plots Total.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows that the highest level graduate students earned a mean salary of $40,000 in 2000, and $60,000 in 2018. Between 2000 and 2018 mean earnings of highest level graduate students increased by just short of 50% over the eight year period covered. The rises were relatively modest in the early period covered by the chart, stablized around 2008/9 and then increased exponentially after that, increasing in rate towards 2018.
